'''Reena University''', also known as the '''University of Reena''', was a [[University/Legends|university]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reena/Legends|Reena]]. It was founded<ref name="LotE" /> in [[197 BBY]]<ref name="Construction date" /> and was one of the most prestigious universities in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It attracted some of the best [[Professor/Legends|professors]] and [[researcher]]s from the sector&mdash;including the rival [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]]&mdash;by offering subsidized salaries far above anything else offered in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Lord [[Galen Panos]] was once the [[Dean/Legends|Dean]] of this institution before he became [[High Lord]] of [[House Reena/Legends|House Reena]]<ref name="LotE" /> around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Galen Panos date">The ''[[Lords of the Expanse]] Sector Guide'' notes that the campaign setting begins in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The ''Lords of the Expanse Gamemaster Guide'' states that [[Galen Panos]] held the position of [[High Lord]] for nearly 30 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] by the year of 3 ABY, which would place his ascension around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref>

The university had maintained a vast [[megacomputer]] [[Reena University archive|archive]] that conlained information on
the history of the Tapani sector. The archive was situated on its own island, and not only was the land protected with [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droid]]s, but the surrounding waters were patrolled by the university security staff.<ref name="LotE" />
